# @ratmath/analytic

> Certified calculus on exact rationals: function values, ranges, integrals, zeros, extrema, limits, Taylor models and validated ODE steps, built on @ratmath/core. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as analytic from "@ratmath/analytic"`.

Built from 0.1.0, commit fca3208. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/analytic/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/analytic/blob/fca3208/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/analytic/. Full types: index.d.ts. `(Q ⇒ E)` is a Refinement: `.quick.value` is the float preview Q at once, `.exact()` the exact E.

Types: `type RationalLike = Rational | bigint | number | string`; `type IntervalLike = [RationalLike, RationalLike] | RationalInterval | DomainClass`; `type ExpressionLike = string | Ast`; `type Params = Record<string, RationalLike>`; `type Trust = "good" | "rough" | "unsure" | string`; `type EndLike = "inf" | "-inf" | "+inf" | "∞" | "-∞" | number`; `type RegionSpec = string | IntervalLike | Region | ((x: Rational) => boolean)`; `type PieceSpec = [RegionSpec, ExpressionLike | AnalyticFunction | number | bigint]`; `type RegionLike = Record<string, [RationalLike | string, RationalLike | string]> | Array<[RationalLike | string, RationalLike | string]> | string | object`; `type PointLike = RationalLike | string | RationalInterval`; `type Bounds = Record<string, [RationalLike | string, RationalLike | string]>`; `type OneStepMethod = "euler" | "heun" | "midpoint" | "rk4" | "ab2"`; `type FourierConvention = "angular" | "unitary" | "frequency"`; `type TransformEnd = RationalLike | string | number`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/analytic/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Introduction), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), fast (Fast, then certified), models (Taylor models), values (Values to many digits), expressions (Formulas and derivatives), ranges (Ranges and integrals), zeros (Zeros, poles and extrema), piecewise (Piecewise functions), odes (Differential equations), bvp (Boundary value problems), methods (First-order equations: the methods), linearodes (Linear equations and Laplace transforms), switches (Steps and impulses), systems (Systems in the plane), seriessolutions (Series solutions), pdes (Heat, waves and potentials), several (Several variables), improper (Limits and improper integrals), special (Special functions), fourier (Fourier series), transforms (The Fourier transform), dft (The discrete Fourier transform), series (Your own series), sequences (Sequences), sums (Series and convergence tests), power (Power series and uniform convergence), theorems (Green, Stokes and the divergence theorem), multipliers (Change of variables, potentials, multipliers), curves (Curves: length, curvature, torsion), surfaces (Surfaces and curvature), geodesics (Geodesics and Gauss-Bonnet), floats (Floating point, exactly), rootmethods (Root-finding methods), interpolation (Interpolation and approximation), quadraturerules (Differences and quadrature rules), odemethods (Euler to Runge-Kutta)

## Example

```js
import { exp, sin, fn, ode, zeros } from "@ratmath/analytic";
const f = fn("exp(sin(x))*x");
console.log("float preview:", f.value("1/3").quick.value);
console.log("certified, 30 digits:", f.value("1/3", { digits: 30 }).exact());
console.log("derivative:", f.derivative().toString());
console.log("∫ from 0 to 1:", f.integral(0, 1, { digits: 10 }).exact());
console.log("zeros of x^3 - 3x + 1:");
for (const z of zeros("x^3 - 3x + 1", [-3, 3]).exact()) console.log("  ", z.kind, z.lo, "to", z.hi, z.unique ? "(exactly one)" : "");
ode.solve({ f: "y^2 + t", y0: "1/2", until: "1/2" }).exact().final
```
